description: Legendary UI Transformation - Rebuild entire UI with new color palette, advanced animations, glassmorphism, 3D effects, particle systems, and full mobile responsiveness to surpass Crevo's design
steps: 1. Update tailwind.config.ts: Add new color palette - extend colors with primary gradient (purple.500: #8B5CF6, purple.600: #7c3aed, indigo.500: #6366F1, indigo.600: #4f46e5), secondary (teal.500: #14B8A6, teal.600: #0d9488), accent (pink.500: #EC4899, pink.600: #db2777), background gradients (slate.900: #0F172A, slate.800: #1E293B, slate.950: #020617). Add new animations: 'glow', 'float-slow', 'shimmer-slow', 'gradient-shift', 'pulse-glow', 'fade-in-up', 'scale-in', 'slide-in-right'. Add backdrop-blur utilities.

2. Update app/globals.css: Add new glass effect classes (.glass-strong with rgba(255,255,255,0.1) + blur(20px), .glass-card with rgba(255,255,255,0.05) + blur(16px)), gradient text utilities (.gradient-primary, .gradient-secondary, .gradient-accent), animated gradient backgrounds (@keyframes gradient-shift), glow effects for buttons (.btn-glow with box-shadow transitions), improve grain overlay to be more subtle (opacity 0.02 instead of 0.03)

3. Install additional animation packages: npm install react-confetti-explosion react-type-animation react-intersection-observer (for scroll-triggered animations), @tsparticles/react @tsparticles/slim (for particle effects if desired, or skip if too heavy)

4. Create components/ui/ParticleBackground.tsx: Subtle floating particle effect for hero section using CSS-only animated divs (not tsparticles - too heavy), ~30 small dots with random positions, slow float animation with different delays, blur effect, purple/cyan gradient colors

5. Rebuild app/page.tsx (Homepage/Hero): (a) Add animated gradient background using gradient-shift animation from purple → indigo → teal, (b) Add ParticleBackground component, (c) Hero heading with gradient text + fade-in-up animation, (d) Replace static creator cards with 3D tilt effect using Framer Motion transform + rotateX/rotateY on hover (react-tilt alternative using Motion), (e) Add floating animation to feature icons, (f) CTA buttons with glow effect on hover + scale animation, (g) Scroll-triggered fade-in for 'How It Works' section using Intersection Observer

6. Rebuild components/creators/CreatorCard.tsx: (a) Enhanced glassmorphism with .glass-card class, (b) Animated gradient border on hover using pseudo-element with gradient-shift animation, (c) Verified badge with pulsing glow animation (box-shadow pulse), (d) Tool badges with individual hover effects (scale + glow), (e) Avatar with gradient ring border, (f) Smooth image zoom on hover (scale-105 → scale-110 with longer duration), (g) Add 'View Profile' button overlay on hover with backdrop-blur, (h) Stats row with count-up animation using react-intersection-observer + custom counter

7. Rebuild components/layout/Navbar.tsx: (a) Strong glass effect (.glass-strong + border-b border-white/10), (b) Logo with gradient text, (c) Active nav link with animated gradient underline (width 0 → 100% transition), (d) Tools dropdown with glass effect + scale-in animation, (e) User avatar with online status indicator (green pulsing dot), (f) Notification bell with pulse animation when unread count > 0, (g) Mobile hamburger menu with smooth slide-in animation

8. Rebuild app/dashboard/page.tsx: (a) Stat cards with gradient backgrounds + count-up animations (use custom useCountUp hook), (b) Engagement stepper with animated SVG progress lines (stroke-dashoffset animation), (c) Primary action card with stronger gradient + glow effect, (d) Proposal cards with glass effect + hover lift animation, (e) 'Mark Delivered' button with confetti explosion on click using react-confetti-explosion, (f) Recent activity feed with slide-in-right animation for each item (staggered delays)

9. Rebuild app/briefs/new/page.tsx (AI Brief Builder): (a) Form fields with glass inputs + focus glow effect (border glow with purple gradient), (b) AI generation loading state with typing animation effect for each field using react-type-animation, (c) Brief Intelligence panel (right sidebar) with animated score ring (SVG circle with stroke-dashoffset animation from 0 to score), color-coded: green >80, yellow 60-80, red <60, (d) Error/Warning/Tip items slide in with icons, (e) 'Generate with AI' button with shimmer effect on hover, (f) 'Publish Brief' button with confetti on success, (g) Match results with creator cards sliding up in sequence

10. Rebuild components/briefs/BriefIntelligence.tsx: (a) Animated score ring using Framer Motion SVG circle, (b) Score number with count-up animation, (c) Error/warning/tip sections with expandable accordions (smooth height animation), (d) Each item fades in with stagger, (e) Icons with pulse animation for errors, (f) Overall glass card design with subtle gradient background

11. Rebuild components/creators/StyleDNA.tsx: (a) SVG radar chart with animated path drawing (stroke-dashoffset), (b) Each axis label fades in with delay, (c) Data point dots pulse on hover, (d) Gradient fill for the shape area (purple → cyan radial gradient), (e) Tooltip on hover showing exact score per axis, (f) Legend with animated color swatches

12. Create components/ui/Button.tsx: Reusable button component with variants (primary with gradient + glow, secondary glass, outline), sizes (sm, md, lg), disabled state, loading spinner, hover scale + glow animations, support for icons

13. Create components/ui/SkeletonScreen.tsx: Shimmer skeleton components for loading states (CreatorCardSkeleton already exists - enhance with new shimmer animation, create BriefCardSkeleton, ProposalCardSkeleton, DashboardStatSkeleton)

14. Create components/ui/Toast.tsx: Custom toast notification component with slide-in animation from top-right, auto-dismiss after 5s, variants (success green gradient, error red gradient, info purple gradient, warning yellow gradient), progress bar animation, replace or enhance Sonner toasts

15. Full mobile responsiveness audit and fixes: (a) Navbar collapses to hamburger menu on mobile with slide-out drawer, (b) Creator cards stack in single column on mobile (<640px), 2 columns on tablet (640-1024px), 3-4 columns on desktop, (c) Dashboard stat cards 2x2 grid on mobile, 4 columns on desktop, (d) Brief builder form full-width on mobile, side-by-side with intelligence panel on desktop, (e) All text sizes scale down appropriately (text-sm on mobile, text-base on desktop for body), (f) Touch-friendly button sizes (min 44x44px tap targets), (g) Test on viewport widths: 320px (iPhone SE), 375px (iPhone X), 768px (iPad), 1024px (iPad Pro), 1920px (Desktop), 2560px (Large Desktop)

16. Add scroll animations throughout: Use react-intersection-observer to trigger fade-in-up animations on scroll for creator cards, how it works steps, stats sections, testimonials (if any), footer sections

17. Performance optimization: (a) Lazy load heavy components (ParticleBackground, confetti, react-type-animation) using next/dynamic with loading fallback, (b) Optimize images with next/image where possible (creator avatars, portfolio thumbnails), (c) Reduce motion for users with prefers-reduced-motion media query (disable complex animations), (d) Debounce hover animations to prevent janky performance
acceptance_criteria: New color palette fully integrated: purple-indigo gradients for primary, teal secondary, pink accents, dark slate backgrounds visible throughout
Hero section has animated gradient background + particle effect + 3D tilt creator cards + fade-in animations
Navbar has glass effect, animated gradient underline on active link, notification bell pulse, mobile hamburger menu
Creator cards have glassmorphism, animated gradient border on hover, pulsing verified badge glow, smooth animations
Dashboard has count-up stat animations, confetti on 'Mark Delivered', animated engagement stepper, glass effect throughout
AI Brief Builder has typing animation during generation, animated score ring in Brief Intelligence, confetti on publish
All buttons have gradient + glow on hover with scale animation
Skeleton screens with shimmer effect show during loading states
Toast notifications slide in from top-right with appropriate color variants
Fully responsive on all viewport sizes 320px - 2560px: layouts adapt, text scales, touch targets appropriate, no horizontal scroll
Scroll animations trigger smoothly as user scrolls down pages
No performance issues: animations run at 60fps on modern devices, heavy components lazy loaded
prefers-reduced-motion respected: users who prefer reduced motion see simpler transitions
verification: Run: npm run build - must succeed with no errors
Start dev server: npm run dev

Desktop verification (1920x1080 viewport): (1) Homepage hero has animated gradient + particles, (2) Hover over creator cards shows gradient border animation + 3D tilt effect, (3) Click navbar links shows animated gradient underline, (4) Dashboard stat cards count up from 0 on page load, (5) Click 'Mark Delivered' triggers confetti, (6) AI Brief Builder shows typing animation when generating, score ring animates from 0 to score, (7) All glass effects visible with backdrop-blur

Mobile verification (375x667 iPhone X): (1) Navbar hamburger menu slides out smoothly, (2) Creator cards stack in single column, (3) Dashboard stats show 2x2 grid, (4) Brief builder form is full-width with intelligence panel below, (5) All tap targets are at least 44x44px, (6) No horizontal scroll on any page, (7) Text is readable (not too small)
Tablet verification (768x1024 iPad): (1) Creator cards show 2 columns, (2) Dashboard shows stat cards in appropriate grid, (3) Brief builder form side-by-side with intelligence panel if space permits

Performance check: (1) Open Chrome DevTools, (2) Performance tab, record page load and interaction, (3) Verify animations run at 60fps, (4) No layout shifts or janky scrolling, (5) Lighthouse performance score >80

Accessibility check: (1) Enable prefers-reduced-motion in browser, (2) Verify complex animations are disabled or simplified, (3) All interactive elements keyboard accessible, (4) Color contrast meets WCAG AA (use browser inspector to check)
Cross-browser check: Test on Chrome, Firefox, Safari (if Mac available) - all animations and effects work correctly
